kana_trigrams.txt, text_trigrams.txt, korean_syllables.txt and korean_words.txt are
character n-gram, syllable and word counts computed from sentences of the Tatoeba corpus (https://tatoeba.org),
by its contributors, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France (CC BY 2.0 FR,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/fr/). Changes: the Japanese sentences were
transcribed to romaji and back to kana, and only frequency counts (and the list of Korean words seen) are distributed, not
the sentences themselves.
